name: Splash texture stack
purpose: A full-bleed photograph overlaid with four blended texture films. This is the site's signature brand device and appears on 4 routes.

opacity.note: 0.1 in the final-CTA splash, 0.25 in the mid-page About/Careers splash — two real, measured values, not one

constraints: The four texture layers are a fixed, ordered set. A generator may not add, remove, or reorder them, and may not change the blend modes.
